meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage channel integration via Chat SDK. Local (macOS) or remote (Photon API) mode.

copy.tagline: 集成 iMessage 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 iMessage 发送功能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add iMessage sending to your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你将 iMessage 集成到 NanoClaw 机器人。你需选择本地（macOS，需完全磁盘访问）或远程（Photon API）模式，然后按提示配置环境、重启服务并输入你的 iMessage 号码或邮箱。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 的 setup 流程中或手动运行该技能的应用步骤时触发。它会在你选择模式后逐步执行复制适配器、安装依赖、配置环境等操作。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 频道，使用本地模式。
say.note: Claude 会询问是否已授予节点完全磁盘访问权限。
Claude 会解析该号码并配置为你的身份标识。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to integrate iMessage into NanoClaw. You choose local (macOS, needs Full Disk Access) or remote (Photon API) mode, then follow prompts to configure environment, restart service, and enter your iMessage handle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run this skill during NanoClaw's setup or manually. It proceeds step-by-step after you pick a mode: copy adapter, install dependency, set env vars, etc.

say_en.text: Add iMessage channel using local mode.
say_en.note: Claude will ask if Full Disk Access is granted.
Claude resolves this handle and sets it as your identity.

say_en.text: Switch to remote mode with Photon server URL https://myphoton.example.com.
say_en.note: Claude asks for API key then configures remote connection.
